responsibility: This header declares GCC’s public runtime-parameter interface. It defines the param_info metadata structure, the compiler_param enum generated from params.list, accessors and mutators for parameter lookup, validation, initialization, and default handling, the PARAM_VALUE macro for reading active values from global options, and many convenience macros naming commonly used parameters for optimization code. It is the central API through which the compiler and plugins query and manipulate --param-controlled tuning values.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations and consumer-facing interface for the parameter subsystem—param_info, compiler_param enum inclusion, function prototypes, PARAM_VALUE, and convenience macros—whereas params.c implements the machinery and params.def supplies the underlying parameter catalogue.
